name: @12-apps/realtime
description: Generic, portable realtime EVENT SYSTEM. Framework-free core (typed topic/event envelopes and a publish/subscribe bus behind a swappable driver port: Redis pub/sub across processes, inline in-process for dev and tests), host-mounted backend surface (./server: topic registry, subscribe authorization seam, SSE transport, connection tickets, per-subject connection caps and the transactional outbox), Hono adapter (./hono), a runnable WebSocket gateway (./gateway plus a realtime-gateway bin), the browser half (./react: createWebEvents — client, reconnect policy with jitter, ws->sse demotion, liveness watch, cross-tab SharedWorker and React hooks), the SharedWorker body (./worker), the publisher-parity gate (./parity) and the package-owned Prisma partial + migrations. Standardized adoption contract in ADOPTING.md.

env.name: REALTIME_TICKET_SECRET
env.description: Signs WS tickets; falls back to AUTH_SECRET, and without either the API serves no WS transport while the gateway refuses to boot.

env.name: REALTIME_DRIVER
env.description: redis | off; unset picks by REDIS_URL and NODE_ENV, invalid values disable realtime with an error log.

env.name: REDIS_URL
env.description: The fan-out bus; REALTIME_DRIVER=redis without it disables realtime with an error log.

env.name: REALTIME_TENANT_CONNECTION_CAP
env.description: Max concurrent sockets per tenant; default 20.

env.name: REALTIME_GATEWAY_PORT
env.description: The gateway process's listen port; default 3100, malformed values throw at boot.

env.name: REALTIME_GATEWAY_MAX_CONNECTIONS
env.description: The gateway process's global socket cap; malformed values throw at boot.
